package.name: ballistic_solver
package.description:
Ballistic solver package for RoboMaster Auto Aim system.
Computes pitch and yaw angles required to hit a target position, considering gravity and air resistance. Supports both static and moving targets.
Features: - Iterative trajectory calculation with gravity compensation - Air resistance model support (ideal and resistance-based) - Moving target prediction - ROS2 service interface for real-time queries
